title: feat(plugin-auth): read the AI assistants a person has authorized, and when each was last used
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DN53GvpyR9kuEwj3GGM9RrE)_ domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1LNDAUs8pz7DNjQFC Fixes #30918 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6683953156 (the full re-post of 6683760626 with this branch, the stamp's home and the dogfood classification rows) · Branch: `claude/project-thread-tmgp4d` · Access boundary: security#1's 6683642288, rules 1 to 7, with the seat's rule-2 reading 6683944651 · Draft: owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review against those rules, arranged by the seat. How the two lines were derived. **Clause-②: yes (widening)**: two new served reads (`AUTH_ROUTE_LEDGER` rows, `sdk`), two new `@objectstack/client` methods with two new exported types, and one new nullable column; nothing existing is removed or tightened. **Metadata-protocol: none**: the new `sys_oauth_consent.last_used_at` is a data column on a shipped, better-auth-managed object (`lock: 'full'`, `apiEnabled: false`), declared as an ordinary `Field.datetime({ readonly: true, required: false })` in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-consent.object.ts`. No metadata author can write it, and no key, accepted value or metadata type changes. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：新增两个只读接口。`GET /api/v1/auth/authorized-clients` 让本人看到自己授权过的 AI 助手(Claude Desktop、IDE 助手等 MCP 客户端)及每个最近一次使用的时间。`GET /api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients?userId=` 让平台管理员查看某个人的授权，逐行标明所属组织。`@objectstack/client` 对应新增 `oauth.authorizedClients.list()` / `.listForUser()`。服务端在 MCP 令牌验证通过后记录“最近使用时间”，精确到小时。 - 为什么改：同意页告诉用户“可随时撤回授权”，但用户和管理员都看不到有哪些 AI 助手能以他的身份行事、最近还在不在用。控制台页面 #30894 需要这两个接口。 - 风险与回滚：本人接口只按会话本人取数，带任何参数都直接 400，不会读别人的。管理员接口与管理端会话接口同一道平台管理员门槛：组织所有者、组织管理员和普通成员都拿到同一个 403，目标人是否存在不影响回答。回答里没有任何令牌、授权码或密钥。时间戳每个进程内每个授权每小时最多写一次，写在请求结束之后，写失败不影响 MCP 调用，每种不同的失败在每个进程里报一次。回滚即撤 PR，新增的那一列为空列，可以留着不管。 - 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/authorized-clients-read.ts`(两个接口的拒绝顺序和返回字段)，`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` 里 `admin/authorized-clients` 那段(门槛在读参数之前)，`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/mcp-client-last-use.ts` 的 `record`(每小时一次的判断)。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/authorized-clients-read.real-plugin.test.ts src/mcp-client-last-use.real-engine.test.ts`，预期 18/18 通过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes **Two reads** (`authorized-clients-read.ts`, mounted in `auth-plugin.ts` ahead of the better-auth catch-all): - `GET /api/v1/auth/authorized-clients` (rule 1): the session user's own OAuth consents. The query set is closed and empty, so `?userId=` or any other parameter is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the parameter. It is never ignored, because an ignored selector reads exactly like an honoured one, which is what better-auth's own `get-consents` does with a `userId`. Order: `401` with no session, then a held session's `403`, then the query check, then the read. - `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients?userId=ID` (rules 2 to 4): gated by `gateAdmin(c)`, the ADR-0068 D2 `judgePlatformAdmin` judge with a held session refused per ADR-0069 D3. That is the gate every ObjectStack `/admin/*` mount and `sys-session/revoke` use; the reading is in 6683944651. The gate runs before the query is read, so a caller outside reach gets one byte-identical refusal whoever `userId` names and whether that person exists. An organization owner or admin is not a platform admin and is refused. Rows span every organization the person granted in, and each names its `organizationId` (rule 3). Read only: there is no withdraw door here (rule 4). Past the gate, a missing, empty or repeated `userId` or an unknown parameter is `400`, and an id naming no user is `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. - The answer (rule 5): `{ success: true, data: { clients, truncated } }`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, newest grant first. Each row carries exactly `id` (the consent id, the key `/oauth2/delete-consent` takes), `clientId`, `name`, `scopes`, `organizationId`, `authorizedAt` and `lastUsedAt`. Nothing identifies or reconstructs a token: the consent and client reads name their columns, so no secret column is ever loaded. At most 200 rows, with `truncated: true` past that. **The last-use stamp** (rule 6; `mcp-client-last-use.ts`, wired in `AuthManager.verifyMcpAccessToken`): - Home: `sys_oauth_consent.last_used_at` (option A of the claim). A consent is the grant the person sees and withdraws, it is held per organization, and a withdrawn or revoked consent is a deleted row, so no usage record outlives its grant. - Writer: only after `verifyMcpAccessToken` admits a token, from the verified principal (`sub`, `azp`, `organization_id`) and the server clock. The consent is chosen by the provider's own `findConsent` rule. A token with no `azp` stamps nothing. No request field reaches it, and the provider's consent doors do not carry it: `update-consent`'s zod body strips it, which is pinned. - Coarse, one clock hour: the value is the hour's start, and a row is written only when its stored hour is older than the current one. Each process also remembers the hour it settled per (client, user, organization), so a busy assistant costs no I/O inside an hour: at most one read and one write per consent per hour per process. The hour is the granularity that answers "is this laptop's assistant still acting as me?" and that an administrator can be shown without exposing a minute-by-minute activity trail. - Off the request path (`runAfterResponse`): the verdict never waits on the stamp. Each distinct failure (by message, at most 16) is logged once per process at `error` (with `console.error` when the manager has no logger) and retried next hour, never next call. A consent withdrawn between the stamp's read and its write is not a failure: the engine's by-id `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` on that write counts as done, so the race cannot use up the report a real outage needs. **Around them:** two `AUTH_ROUTE_LEDGER` rows (`sdk`, `oauth.authorizedClients.list` / `.listForUser`) and the conformance own-list pin. `@objectstack/client` gets `oauth.authorizedClients.list()` / `.listForUser(userId)` and the exported `AuthorizedClient` / `AuthorizedClientsList` types. The field is declared in `platform-objects` and its four regenerated translation bundles carry hand-written zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES text. The two `/admin/` dogfood sweeps get classification rows only: `objectstack-gate` with `?userId=`, and `ADMITTED` with its query, as #30398 did for `client-address`. `oauth-provider-schema-parity.test.ts` gains a pin that no provider consent field resolves to `last_used_at`. The tenant audit census counts the stamp's one system-context write: 261 → 262, regenerated by its own script, with the page's prose numbers moved to match. ## Tests On the real plugin. A real `AuthManager` (real better-auth, real `customSession`, real sign-ups and sessions) serves the real `AuthPlugin` routes on a Hono app. Consents are written through better-auth's own adapter, so the read decodes exactly what the provider stores. `authorized-clients-read.real-plugin.test.ts`, 10 cases: - a member reads exactly their own grants, newest first, exact key set, no client secret, access/refresh token or session token in the text (the card's first; rules 1 and 5); - a member's `?userId=` is `400` and carries none of the other's rows (rule 7, first clause); - every other parameter is `400` (closed set); - anonymous is `401` on both doors; - `truncated` past the cap, newest first; - a platform admin reads a person's grants across two organizations plus one with none, each naming its organization (the card's second; rule 3); - **rule 7**: a member, an organization OWNER and an organization ADMIN of the target's organization, and the target themself, each get `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` byte-identical for an existing id, a nonexistent id and no id (the card's third); - **rule 7, outside their organizations**: the organization owner and admin of Acme, naming a person who is only in Beta, get the same `403` bytes as for a person inside Acme, with none of the person's rows; - admin `400` for missing, empty, whitespace, repeated and unknown parameters, `404` for an id naming no user; - an empty list, not a refusal, for a person with no grants. `mcp-client-last-use.real-engine.test.ts`, 8 cases, on ObjectQL + better-sqlite3, so the column is the one schema sync creates and tokens are minted by the real jwt plugin: - 25 verified calls in one hour make 1 write and 1 read with the hour's start; later in the same hour, 0 I/O; the next hour, 1 more write; the admin read answers that hour start; - a second process on the same store makes 1 read and 0 writes in an hour already stamped; - the stamp follows the token's organization claim and touches no sibling consent; - wrong audience, an unpublished key, an expired token, garbage and a `client_id`-only token stamp nothing, against a positive control in the same process; - `update-consent` with `lastUsedAt` / `last_used_at` in its body moves the scopes and leaves the stamp `null`, and the next verified call writes the server's hour; - a failing store: 16 calls over two hours, every verdict still answered, 2 attempts, 1 `error` report naming the column; - two different failures over three hours (locked store, missing column, locked store again) give 3 attempts and 2 reports, one per distinct message; - the withdrawal race on the real engine: the consent is deleted after the stamp's read, the write meets `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and nothing is reported; a later missing-column outage in the same process is still reported. Plus `oauth-authorized-clients.test.ts` (client URLs, encoding, unwrap, throw on refusal, types), the parity pin and the ledger conformance pin.
Ablations: one-shot, uncommitted, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob - **Subject keying, honoured selector**: the own read answers `request.queries.userId?.[0] ?? subject` with the closed-query check removed. Red: "a member who names another person with ?userId= is REFUSED 400", "any other parameter is refused the same way". 2 failed, 7 passed. - **Subject keying, filter dropped**: the consent read's `where: { user_id: userId }` becomes `where: {}`. Red: "a member reads exactly their own grants". 1 failed, 8 passed. - **Admin reach check removed**: `const actor = await gateAdmin(c); if (actor instanceof Response) return actor;` becomes `const actor = {} as any;`. Red: "anonymous is 401 UNAUTHENTICATED on both doors", "rule 7: a member, an organization OWNER and an organization ADMIN are refused with ONE answer". 2 failed, 7 passed. - **Coarseness removed**: the per-process hour memo is deleted and the stored-hour check is replaced by a per-call write of the precise time. Red: all 6 stamp cases (`expected '2026-11-06T10:17:00.050Z' to be '2026-11-06T10:00:00.000Z'`; the failure case `one attempt per hour: expected 16 to be 2`). - **Withdrawn consent counted as a failure** (the `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` no-op deleted): red, "a consent withdrawn between the stamp's read and its write is no failure" (`expected … to have a length of +0 but got 1`). 1 failed, 7 passed. - **First failure only** (`reportedFailures.has(message)` becomes `reportedFailures.size > 0`): red, "reports each DISTINCT failure once" (`expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]`). 1 failed, 7 passed. - **An organization-admin lane** (the admin door also admits any caller holding an `owner` or `admin` membership anywhere): red, both rule 7 cases, the new one with Acme's admin answered `200` with Beta's `client_beta_only`. 2 failed, 8 passed. Each run printed `ok mutation landed` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed) and `ok restored: blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD is empty`.
## Acceptance notes - **Rule 2 reading.** `/admin/list-user-sessions` is better-auth's, gated on the legacy `role = 'admin'` scalar, and refuses a real ObjectStack platform admin by design (#9969), so its gate cannot be copied literally. This PR uses the gate ObjectStack's admin session door `sys-session/revoke` uses (`judgePlatformAdmin`), as recorded in 6683944651 for security#1 to confirm or correct. A platform admin's reach crosses the tenant wall on better-auth objects (ADR-0095 D1), so the admin read is not bounded to one organization, and every row names its organization instead. - **Extension field mechanism.** The claim names ADR-0105 D7's `MANAGED_EXTENSION_FIELDS`. That guard's own test excludes every `sys_oauth_*` object with "covered by `oauth-provider-schema-parity.test.ts`", so the collision pin (no provider field may resolve to `last_used_at`) is written there instead, and `MANAGED_EXTENSION_FIELDS` is unchanged. - **Serial constraint with #30879 (revoke).** This diff touches `auth-manager.ts` (the `.then` on `verifyMcpAccessToken` plus one private method) and the header of `auth-manager-mcp-access-token.ts`, and nothing else #30879 edits. Per the claim, it lands after #30879 and rebases on it. Once both land, #30879's per-request consent read and this stamp's hourly read could share one read; not done here. - **A banned subject's verified token still stamps.** The ban refusal runs after `verifyMcpAccessToken`, in the runtime's MCP door. The stamp then records an attempt the door refused, still at most once an hour. Moving the ban check is outside this card, and the seat filed it as #30949. - **Deployments without schema sync** lack the column: both reads answer `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` and the stamp logs that error naming the column, once per process. Existing consent rows read `lastUsedAt: null`; a consent older than the provider's `createdAt` reads `authorizedAt: null`. - **Docs.** No page lists these routes or claims there is no such read, so no sentence had to change. The console page is #30894. - **Outside the claimed file surface: two generated census files.** `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` (a `content/docs` page, but its prose counts are not route sentences) and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`. `check-tenant-audit-census` is a derived gate and goes red on any new engine write, so both were regenerated by `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`, and the page's six prose numbers were moved to match. Reported to the seat. ## Verification **Delta on head `9688e17ce3`** (contract review 6686013581: should-fix 1, 3 and 4; 5 files, +170 / -23, all in plugin-auth and its changeset): the two real-plugin files 18/18; `auth-manager.mcp-oauth`, `-mcp-verifier-keyring`, `-mcp-oauth-resource`, `oauth-provider-schema-parity` and the ledger conformance test 114/114; plugin-auth `typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0; `eslint` on the four changed source and test files exit 0; `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-issue-citations`, `check:auth-mount-ledger` and `check-comment-mask-corpus` exit 0. Should-fix 2 (one undecodable `scopes` row answers `500`) is left as built, as the seat directed. The rest of this section is the original run, on head `121bdd35a4`: All on head `121bdd35a4` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `4d56914aa`; the delta against `main` is 24 files, +1874 / -31, of which 891 lines are the two real-plugin test files), after a whole-tree `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (118/118 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 230 passed (230), Tests 4112 passed, 10 skipped (4122), VERDICT command-exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: Test Files 55 passed (55), Tests 708 passed (708), including `client-url-conformance.test.ts` (both new methods driven and matched to their ledger rows) and `auth-route-ledger-coverage.test.ts`. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 117 passed (117), Tests 1591 passed (1591). - `typecheck` for plugin-auth, client, platform-objects and dogfood, plus `check:test-typecheck` for plugin-auth and client: all exit 0. - The two `/admin/` dogfood sweeps, run locally against the booted stack: `admin-route-nonadmin-refusal` and `admin-platform-admin-standing`, Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 15 passed (15). Positive control: with the `ADMITTED` entry deleted, the standing sweep goes red naming `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients` as unclassified (1 failed, 7 passed), so the sweep derives the new mount. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 98 families on this head. Each ran sequentially with its exit code captured before any pipe: all 98 exit 0. `--ran`: "98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `pnpm lint`: exit 0. On the first pass, `check-tenant-audit-census` (and its self-test, which reads the live tree) went red on the stamp's new write site, which is fixed by the census commit. `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (no build output) until the whole-tree build ran. - `check:i18n` exit 0 after `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` plus the three hand translations; `check:i18n-stale-fill` exit 0. `check:i18n-coverage` is not in the derived set and was not measured (it needs the examples' build closure). - Every family CI runs on this PR is read from the PR's check runs, not re-run here. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (`last_used_at` snake_case column; camelCase wire members.) - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Three `patch` changesets: plugin-auth, client, platform-objects.) - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.) - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_016WV4d1LNDAUs8pz7DNjQFC)_
